head: Uber women drivers option comes to Canada, plus live video for teen trips
dek: Uber Canada is adding Women Driver Preferences this month, so women, non-binary riders and teens can ask for a woman driver in participating cities. Parents can also check in on a teen's ride through live video.
details: Riders can book a woman driver ahead of time in participating cities, and ask for one on demand in some areas; Uber hasn't named the cities and says it can't promise a match every time, so waits may be longer. Live video uses the driver's phone camera, only works when the driver has turned it on, is encrypted, and tells the teen and the driver when a guardian is watching. Since 2023, women and non-binary drivers in Canada could already choose to pick up women riders. Senior accounts, with larger text and the option to tell drivers you need extra time at pickup, can now be set up and run by seniors themselves.
where: Canada, rolling out in November in participating cities
means: If you ride Uber in Canada, you can ask for a woman driver, though you may wait longer. If your teen rides alone, you can look in on the trip.
todo: Update the Uber app and look for the women driver option when you book. A match isn't guaranteed: you can keep waiting, book for later or take any driver.
thumb_words: UBER CANADA: ASK FOR A WOMAN DRIVER
